name: Kailua Liʻi Pōʻalua 2024
information: ### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with a special 3-day series WCA competition! Choose between Kailua Li'i [Pōʻakahi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KailuaLiiPoakahi2024), [Pōʻalua](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KailuaLiiPoalua2024), or [Pōʻakolu](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KailuaLiiPoakolu2024) for three different set of events to compete in! * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor, it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 4:30 PM. #### You may only be allowed to compete in one of the three competitions in the Kailua Li'i Series. If you register for more than one competition, only your most recent registration will be accepted. ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png) ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png/v1/fit/w_2500,h_1330,al_c/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png)
